Position: Continuous Improvement Specialist 

Direct Supervisor: Lean & 6-Sigma Manager

The primary role of the Continuous improvement Specialist is assisting the lean & 6-Sigma Manager to lean and advance the department planning and the overall operation planning. Meantime, grasping the company business conditions in times and distinguishing the improving program from quality, effectiveness, inventory, and material consumption etc. Updating well organized work plans and project management documents on time. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Occasional travel is expected for this position.

With one or more years of plastic processing and design experience, an undergraduate degree and/or a combination of education and experience.

detail.title: Assistant Quality Manager - Quality Dept
detail.jobDescription:
I. Job ProfileJob TitleAssistant Quality ManagerDepartmentQuality
Direct SupervisorQuality ManagerDirect SubordinatesCustomer Quality Engineer, Quality Performance Analyst, Quality Data Analyst, Quality Control Data Scientist
II. Job Summary：
1. Establish, maintain, and continuously improve customer quality processes and ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and the Quality Management System (QMS).
 2. Lead the timely and effective resolution of customer complaints, warranty claims, and quality issues through structured problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration.
 3. Monitor customer scorecards, PPM, complaints, warranty performance, external quality losses, and other customer-related KPIs; identify risks and drive improvement actions. 
 4. Lead and support cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, verify corrective action effectiveness, and promote prevention-based quality management.
 5. Maintain effective communication with customers, understand Voice of Customer (VOC), and represent FGA's quality interests while maintaining a constructive customer relationship.
 6. Lead, develop, and manage the customer quality team to ensure appropriate capability, accountability, workload distribution, and performance.
III. Job Functions and Duties
NO.Representative Duties
1Customer Quality Management
 1.1 Establish and maintain customer quality processes, procedures, and related documentation.
 1.2 Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements (CSRs), IATF 16949, and the Quality Management System (QMS).
 1.3 Monitor changes in customer requirements and coordinate internal implementation.
 1.4 Provide training and guidance on customer quality requirements
2Customer Complaint & Warranty Management
 2.1 Manage customer complaints, warranty claims, and field quality issues.
 2.2 Lead cross-functional problem solving, including containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness verification.
 2.3 Ensure timely and effective customer responses and 8D closure.
 2.4 Support warranty analysis, responsibility determination, recovery, and claim dispute activities.
 2.5 Identify recurring issues and drive systemic corrective actions.
3Customer Quality Performance Management
 3.1 Monitor and analyze customer scorecards, PPM, complaints, warranty performance, and external quality losses.
 3.2 Identify performance risks and lead improvement action plans.
 3.3 Report customer quality performance and key risks to management and recommend actions.
 3.4 Ensure accuracy and timeliness of customer quality data and reports.
4Customer Relationship Management
 4.1 Serve as a key quality interface with customers.
 4.2 Maintain effective communication and understand Voice of Customer (VOC).
 4.3 Support customer visits, audits, quality reviews, and escalation activities.
 4.4 Represent FGA's quality position based on facts, data, customer requirements, and company interests.
5Quality Improvement & Audit
 5.1 Support customer, internal, and certification audits and follow up on findings.
 5.2 Drive cross-functional quality improvement and verify effectiveness of corrective actions.
 5.3 Promote the application of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, 8D, and other quality tools.
6Team Management
 6.1 Lead and manage the customer quality team, including work assignment, prioritization, and performance management.
 6.2 Develop team capability through training, coaching, and personnel development plans.
 6.3 Promote accountability, teamwork, and a customer-focused quality culture.
7Reporting
 7.1 Prepare and submit daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual quality reports as required.
 7.2 Prepare customer quality performance reviews and management presentations.
 7.3 Escalate significant quality risks and unresolved customer issues in a timely manner.
8Other Responsibilities
 8.1 Support the Quality Manager in achieving departmental objectives and quality goals.
 8.2 Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Job RequirementsEducation1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related field.
 2. Lean Six Sigma or quality-related certification/training preferred.

 2. 2+ years of experience in quality leadership, supervision, or project leadership.
 3. Experience with customer quality, warranty, and IATF 16949 preferred.
Language1. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 2. Mandarin proficiency preferred.

Other Requirements1. Proficient in using Microsoft Office software Word, Excel, Power Point;
 2. Proficient in IATF Core (Five) Tools and quality statistics knowledge;

 6. Ability to prioritize risks, respond with urgency, make sound decisions, and drive results while protecting company interests.

II. Job Summary：
1. Work with new product development team to coordinate new product sample quality design and plan;
 2. Develop appropriate part quality inspection plans;
 3. Control the new product sample receiving and inspection process;
 4. Conclude the OEM product sample inspection efforts, collect inspection data and perform result analysis;
 5. Analyze root causes for defects and update production quality control plan with Advanced Quality Engineer, and process engineer.
 6. Monitor implementation process of improvement methods and perform effectiveness verification;
 7. Handling the customer complaints and concerns with Advanced Quality Engineer during the new product development phase.
 8. Handling the customer complaints and concerns with Customer Quality Engineer on OEM product.
 9. Guide and assistant the production management group to focus on identifying and cotrolling potential fail risk of OEM product.
 
III. Job Functions and Duties
 
NO.Representative Duties
1Work with new product development team to coordinate new product sample inspection:
 1.1 Attend regular meetings with new product development team to discuss new product sample production schedule and shipping schedule;
 1.2 Participate in the new product development process to verify that all applicable requirements are addressed fully;
 1.3 Verify part quality standard and inspection requirements are identified, allocated to and executed by relevant product design and development efforts;
 1.4 Determine product audit sample receiving date and estimate inspection completion date.
2Develop appropriate part quality inspection plans:
 2.1 Propose appropriate part quality inspection plans according to the new product development timelines;
 2.2 Work with tooling engineers and lab technicians to develop necessary testing tools to perform product inspection.
3Control the new product sample receiving and inspection process:
 3.1 Verify all product testing standards, procedures, methods, equipment, and tools are appropriate for the inspection;
 3.2 Monitor sample inspection process, evaluate quality issues found in the process and address any concerns;
 3.3 Coordinate internal and off-site lab resources to conduct necessary tests;
 3.4 Keep racking testing progress and resolve problems that may occur in the process.
4Conclude the OEM product sample inspection efforts, collect inspection data and perform result analysis:
 4.1 Track and document the completion of all inspection duties and certify the completion of qualified OEM product delivery to customer;
 4.2 Summary inspection defect findings, develop defect trends and gather concerns that OEM product inspectors may have during inspection;
 4.3 Compile final product inspection report and make sure customer's specific requirements and internal standards are met;
5Analyze root causes for defects and update production quality control plan with Advance Quality Engineer and Process Engineer:
 5.1 Communicate with production team regarding issues found during the inspection;

This role ensures equipment reliability through regular inspections, modifications, and upgrades while maintaining a clean and organized work environment. Additionally, the technician provides training on equipment operations and best practices.

 

Essential Functions:

  1. Ensure the smooth operation of automation equipment through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting.
  2. Manage and maintain an accurate inventory of spare parts related to automation equipment.
  3. Regularly back up and update automation programs to ensure system reliability and efficiency.
  4. Develop and implement equipment modification and upgrade plans, as well as inspection schedules.
  5. Perform routine hardware inspections, including dust protection, component tightening, and replacement of worn parts.
  6. Maintain a clean and organized work environment in compliance with 5S standards.
  7. Provide training and guidance on equipment operation and best practices to relevant personnel.

 

Competencies:

  1. Robotics Programming and Mechatronics
  2. Problem Solving and Analysis
  3. Project Management
  4. Communication Proficiency
  5. Ethical Conduct
  6. Time Management


Supervisory Responsibility:

This position has no supervisor responsibility.


Work Environment:

  1. This position is primarily on the facility floor with light desk work. Regularly working with automation equipment and mechanical tools.
  2. Must be 18 years or older.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:
this is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.


Travel:

Sometimes travel to our supplier may happen.


Required Education and Experience:

  1. Basic mechanical aptitude and manufacturing plant experience.
  2. Minimum of one year of general robotics maintenance and programming experience.


Preferred Education and Experience:

  1. Five or more years of maintenance experience.
  2. Understanding of injection molding machine systems, including electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
  3. Advanced robotics experience, including programming.

Job Title: EH&S Technician 

· Job Summary 

o Responsible for providing a safe and healthy working environment for all employees. Implement improvement systems in order to eliminate work-related inquires and ensure all employees are educated in safe work conditions, practices, and safety requirements. Work with EHS leadership team to develop the EHS management systems to aim in maintaining the safe workplace expected.  

· Job Functions 

o Safety in the Work Environment: 

§ Evaluate work environment to ensure safe practices are established to prevent injuries, accidents, and eliminate work hazards   

§ Design and implement safety program to include PPE, hearing protection and noise mapping, heat stress, LOTO, confined space, hot permit program, electrical safety and fork truck safety, as part of the initial implementation plan

§ Document interviews with employees and witnesses to the accident/injury.

§ Communicate details of accident and/or injury to EH&S Assistant Manager and/or Manager    

§ Complete and submit, if necessary, worker's compensation report, OSHA log, and other regulatory agencies, including environmental reporting    

§ Update and maintain injury and accident statistics to evaluate performance level of program

The Design & Development Component Engineer ensures the timely and accurate development, improvement, and validation of automotive accessories and components. This position plays a critical role in controlling product design and development processes while supporting the applicable sales area. The engineer will work closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and quality assurance to optimize product performance and compliance with industry standards.

 

Essential Functions:

  1. Lead the development of accessories, from feasibility evaluation to final validation.
  2. Conduct product quotations, technical planning, and development in coordination with sales and engineering teams.
  3. Develop components based on customer drawings and specifications, ensuring accuracy in design and application.
  4. Oversee supplier selection, accessory code applications, and standard conversions for new components.
  5. Validate and approve first-batch production samples, ensuring alignment with drawings and specifications.
  6. Assist procurement and quality assurance in supplier audits and QTS recognition.
  7. Track accessory development progress, maintain accessory code catalogs, and manage sample production.
  8. Prepare technical documents, inspection reports, and testing results for first article recognition.
  9. Verify and optimize technical processes for accessory installation tools.
  10. Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for accessory development and production.
  11. Support cross-functional teams in continuous improvement initiatives, including:
  12. Kaizen implementation
  13. Cross-training efforts
  14. Problem-solving and defect reduction
  15. Participate in failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to mitigate design risks.
  16. Ensure compliance with relevant automotive industry standards, including IATF 16949.
  17. Other duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  1. Technical Skills:
    1. Strong knowledge of CAD software (AutoCAD, UG NX, CATIA, Pro/E).
    2. Experience with component design, mold structures, and processing technologies.
    3. Understanding of accessory bonding processes and vehicle glazing system components.
    4. Familiarity with polymer materials, small injection molding, and stamping die development.
  2. Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills:
    1. Ability to analyze engineering data and solve practical design and manufacturing challenges.
    2. Strong mathematical skills, including proficiency in unit conversions and cost analysis.
  3. Project & Supplier Management:
    1. Experience in project management, APQP processes, and supplier development.
    2. Knowledge of raw materials, processing costs, and accessory manufacturing capabilities.
  4. Industry Standards & Compliance:
    1. TS16949, Six Sigma, and process improvement methodologies.
    2. Understanding of five automotive reference manuals.
  5. Communication & Collaboration:
    1. Fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking); Mandarin proficiency is a plus.
    2. Strong ability to interact effectively with team members, leadership, engineers, and customers.
    3. Experience in preparing technical reports and conducting training sessions.


Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to: stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The position involves sitting, walking, and lifting 15 pounds for long periods throughout the day.


Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, see Production Manager for hours. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

 

Travel:

Little travel is expected for this position.

Preferred Education and Experience:

16Nothing in the Position Description restricts management's right to assign or re-assign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

detail.title: General Utility
detail.jobDescription:
Fuyao is the largest automotive glass manufacturer in China and the second largest in the world. Fuyao is an established automotive glass manufacturing in the United States in Dayton, OH, and Mt. Zion, IL, investing in excess of $1 Billion in capital. Its main customers include GM, Honda, BMW, Volvo, Volkswagen, FCA, Toyota, Hyundai, and Kia, to name a few.

Fuyao Glass offers an excellent benefits package, including Health, Medical, Dental, Short Disability, as well as a 401(k) plan.

Position Summary:  

The GU employee’s main tasks in closing are to inspect glass containers that are delivered to the closing area prior to closing. A basic visual inspection looking for stagger, breakage, bad cuts, etc. to ensure we deliver a quality product through the closing process ready to ship to our customers. This includes the use of manual, automatic tooling to prep, wrap, and band the glass in the containers. Trucking is also part of this process. At times there will be other tasks or special projects that may be required for the GU to assist in completing.

Primary Duties:  

  • Support packing line operations by preparing containers with the required materials, tools, and equipment necessary to safely and properly package glass products in accordance with customer requirements, work instructions, and quality standards.
  • Transport containers to and from production lines, closing areas, rework areas, staging areas, shipping areas, and storage locations using authorized material handling equipment.
  • Perform container closing activities in accordance with customer specifications, packaging requirements, work instructions, and established operating procedures.
  • Perform container rework activities, including removal of broken glass, elimination of rat holes, correction of side stagger conditions, and other rework tasks required to restore containers to acceptable quality standards.
  • Transfer glass between containers as required while maintaining product quality, identification, and traceability.
  • Operate forklifts and other authorized industrial vehicles to support production, packaging, inventory, and shipping operations.
  • Load and unload containers on launching devices, robot turntables, conveyors, and other production equipment as required.
  • Transport, stage, and position empty racks to support production requirements while minimizing operational downtime.
  • Assist production personnel with glass processing activities, including breakage removal, glass stacking, and other operational support tasks as assigned.
  • Cut, prepare, and package materials required for container preparation, closing, and shipping operations.
  • Cut and fabricate replacement components for damaged or improperly assembled containers in accordance with established standards.
  • Cut paper, cardboard, and other packaging materials as required to support packaging operations.
  • Operate automatic banding equipment and verify banding requirements are applied in accordance with approved packaging standards and banding charts.
  • Empty cullet and waste hoppers in accordance with safety, environmental, and housekeeping requirements.
  • Perform container audits and complete required production, inventory, inspection, and quality records accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Assemble steel racks and related packaging components as required.
  • Assist Maintenance personnel with routine repairs, emergency repairs, and assigned tasks that do not require specialized maintenance qualifications.
  • Identify, report, and assist with containment of nonconforming product, packaging issues, damaged racks, and process abnormalities in accordance with established procedures.
  • Inspect assigned equipment and promptly report equipment malfunctions, damage, and unsafe conditions to supervision.
  • Maintain product identification and traceability throughout assigned operations.
  • Maintain housekeeping and 5S standards in assigned work areas.
  • Follow all company safety, environmental, quality, and operational procedures and perform work in a manner that minimizes environmental impact.
  • Communicate and coordinate effectively with supervisors, operators, maintenance personnel, engineers, and other employees to support operational objectives.
  • Assist during emergencies and support operational recovery efforts as directed.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by Supervisors, Engineers, or Management.

Requirements:  

  • Employee must be able to lift 40 pounds, as needed to perform their required tasks.
  • Must work well with others in a teamwork environment to complete the goals set forward by the management team.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

7:00am - 7:00pm or 7:00pm - 7:00am

detail.title: Project Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Summary/Objective

Leader of Program Management Team (Iron Triangle). 

The Project Engineer works with the Product Development Engineer and Advance Quality Engineer to quote, develop and launch new automotive glass products for OEMs.   The PM will communicate directly with the customer on all matters concerning the initial launch of the program.   Represent Fuyao at customer development events and meetings.  Maintain documents in accordance with Fuyao policies, APQP and Customer deliverables.

 

Essential Functions

  1. New Product Launch - Automotive Glass (Mainly encapsulation) - Capable of handling OEM Customers and multiple programs/window openings.
  2. Internal leader of Iron Triangle and OEM program. Several forms of communication are required: face-to-face meetings, emails, texts, WeChat, verbal, written forms, etc.
  3. Key Player / Value stream leader for the OEM customer - "Voice of the Customer" for internal processes and proceedings. Organize internal teammates and processes to fulfill and support customer deliverables.
  4. Thoroughly understands purchasing procedure process and anticipates and handles any problems and questions pursuant to customer satisfaction.
  5. Maintaining the program budget and timing is a central requirement.  This includes components, tooling, equipment and packaging purchases and development. Responsible for COST: from Quote to Invoice. 
  6. Provide direction and support to program team (Fuyao Automotive North America and China), including scheduling meetings, updating open issues list, and any other project-related information.
  7. Creator of timing charts, ensure ON TIME delivery of products to the customer. Back-up plan and expedited delivery schedules.   Offset of delays
  8. Monitor and report on the progress of the project to all stakeholders, including reporting to company management.
  9. Attending engineering change meetings as needed at customer assembly and technical center. Responsible for implementing the engineering change in the plant.
  10. Within the first 90 days - acquire product and process knowledge - commensurate with leadership role.  Understand and be able to present to customer management core product lines.  
  11. Other duties as assigned by management. Ability to work overtime depending on program timing and be multi-functional. Nothing in the Position Description restricts management's right to assign or re-assign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

 

Competencies

  • Personal Computer literate, with analytical decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

 

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have any direct Supervisory responsibilities. However, managerial skill is expected in the program team.

Work Environment

  1. This job operates between a manufacturing and office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines as well as interfacing with the operation of machinery on the floor.
  2. Must be 18 years or older

 

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. 

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. The position involves sitting, walking, and lifting up to 25 pounds for long periods of time throughout the day. The ability to move around the office environment and on the production floor and the ability to work at a computer workstation is required.

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

 

Travel

Travelling is expected for this position.

 

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business Management
  • COMPUTER SKILLS - MS Office, Excel, Word, PowerPoint. MS Project skilled.
  • Outlook is the email client.  Also, use of Skype, and SharePoint navigation.
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with MRP/ERP software. Currently using Oracle

 

 

Preferred Education and Experience

  • IATF/APQP/PPAP training preferred.

detail.title: Project Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
About the Role:

The Project Engineer - Utility is responsible for planning, engineering, executing, and closing utility and infrastructure projects in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The position leads projects from problem definition and technical scope development through procurement, construction, commissioning, and final turnover. The role supports safe, reliable, code-compliant, and energy-efficient operation of the plant's utility systems while maintaining clear ownership of project cost, schedule, quality, risk, and documentation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Project definition and planning. Evaluate operational needs, recurring failures, capacity constraints, compliance gaps, and energy-saving opportunities; develop project charters, scopes of work, budgetary estimates, schedules, risk registers, and implementation plans.
  • Engineering and technical design. Prepare or review calculations, equipment selections, layouts, one-line diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams, control narratives, technical specifications, bid packages, and construction drawings.
  • Utility systems engineering. Support projects involving medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, compressed air, chilled and cooling water, process water and RO systems, wastewater and water-treatment systems, HVAC and dehumidification, natural gas, building controls, and related plant infrastructure.
  • Capacity and reliability analysis. Analyze current and future utility demand, redundancy, equipment condition, failure history, and production impact; recommend technically and financially justified solutions.
  • Cross-functional coordination. Coordinate requirements and project impacts with Production, Maintenance, Utility Operations, Facility, EHS, Quality, IT/Controls, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders. Communicate constraints, shutdown needs, risks, and decisions in a timely manner.
  • Procurement and vendor management. Develop RFQ packages, conduct site walks, answer bidder questions, complete technical bid evaluations, support vendor selection, and verify that purchased equipment and services meet project requirements.
  • Cost and change control. Track commitments, forecasts, invoices, contingency, and cost-to-complete; review contractor quotations and change orders; promptly escalate deviations from approved scope, budget, or schedule.
  • Construction and contractor coordination. Coordinate field activities, access, permits, material staging, production interfaces, outages, and daily work plans. Inspect installation progress and workmanship and document deficiencies, action items, and recovery plans.
  • Safety and compliance. Integrate applicable OSHA, NFPA, NEC, environmental, insurance, state, and local code requirements into project planning and execution. Coordinate LOTO, energized-work restrictions, hot work, lift plans, confined-space requirements, and other site safety controls with EHS and authorized personnel.
  • Shutdown and cutover planning. Develop detailed method-of-procedure plans, outage schedules, temporary utility arrangements, contingency plans, and restoration steps to minimize production and business interruption.
  • Quality assurance and commissioning. Verify submittals and installation quality; coordinate inspections, testing, FAT/SAT activities, startup, functional performance testing, punch-list closure, training, and formal acceptance.
  • Project turnover and records. Deliver complete closeout packages, including approved drawings, as-built records, equipment data, O&M manuals, test reports, warranties, spare-parts recommendations, PM requirements, and asset information for the CMMS or equipment register.
  • Operational and emergency support. Provide engineering troubleshooting and root-cause support for significant utility failures or project-related issues. Participate in planned shutdowns and occasional after-hours response when business needs require.
  • Energy and continuous improvement. Identify and implement projects that reduce utility consumption, peak demand, operating cost, emissions, water use, and unplanned downtime; establish baselines and verify results using appropriate KPIs.
  • Reporting and governance. Maintain accurate project schedules, meeting minutes, issue logs, risk registers, action lists, forecasts, status reports, and decision records. Follow applicable capital-approval and document-control processes.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Proven experience in project engineering or a similar role within the engineering or construction industry.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to produce and interpret detailed shop drawings.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles and experience using Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling software.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform cost estimation and manage change orders effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with advanced engineering design software beyond AutoCAD.
  • Familiarity with industry-specific codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Previous experience working on large-scale or complex engineering projects.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and review detailed engineering designs and shop drawings using AutoCAD to ensure accuracy and compliance with project specifications.
  • Prepare and manage cost estimations, budgets, and change orders to maintain financial control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate project activities by liaising with internal teams, contractors, and clients to ensure seamless communication and timely delivery of milestones.
  • Utilize Microsoft Project to create, update, and monitor project schedules, identifying potential risks and implementing mitigation strategies.
  • Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and presentations to communicate project status and engineering decisions to stakeholders.

Skills:

The required skills such as AutoCAD and shop drawing expertise are essential for creating precise engineering designs and ensuring technical accuracy on a daily basis. Project engineering and design skills enable the candidate to develop innovative solutions and adapt designs to meet evolving project needs. Cost estimation and change order management are critical for maintaining budgetary control and responding to project scope adjustments efficiently. Project coordination and the use of Microsoft Project facilitate effective scheduling, resource allocation, and communication among stakeholders, ensuring projects progress smoothly. Preferred skills like advanced design software proficiency and leadership capabilities further enhance the ability to manage complex projects and lead teams toward successful outcomes.

Summary/Objective 
Reporting to Fuyao Automotive North America, Inc., this position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations. The EHS Specialist supports injury prevention, regulatory compliance, safety leadership, and environmental management initiatives. This role works closely with the management team to foster a safety-first culture and promote collaboration across departments to enhance workplace safety and efficiency.

 

Essential Functions

  1. Assists in developing, implementing, and maintaining EHS programs, policies, and procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and workplace safety. 
  2. Monitors and interprets changes in EHS regulations, ensuring timely updates to company policies and procedures.

detail.title: Process Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
About the Role:

As a Process Engineer within the Automotive Glass Manufacturing Industry, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and enhancing manufacturing processes to ensure high-quality product delivery and operational efficiency. Your primary focus will be on analyzing current processes, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing innovative solutions that reduce waste and increase productivity. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply chain to align process improvements with business objectives. Utilizing advanced process simulation and control techniques, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives that support sustainable manufacturing practices. Ultimately, your expertise will contribute to delivering superior consumer products while maintaining cost-effectiveness and compliance with industry standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • Proven experience in process engineering within a manufacturing or consumer support environment.
  • Strong knowledge of process simulation tools and methodologies.
  • Proficiency in process control techniques and manufacturing operations.
  • Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.
  • Certification in Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in consumer goods manufacturing or support services.
  • Familiarity with advanced process automation and control systems.
  • Demonstrated success in scrap reduction and waste management projects.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and product quality.
  • Conduct process simulations and modeling to predict and enhance process performance.
  • Implement process control strategies to maintain consistent production standards and reduce variability.
  • Analyze production data using statistical tools such as Minitab to identify trends and root causes of scrap or defects.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing operations teams to troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead initiatives aimed at scrap reduction and waste minimization to support sustainability goals.
  • Document process changes and maintain detailed records to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards.
  • Train and support production staff on new processes and best practices to ensure smooth implementation.

Skills:

The required skills such as Chemical Engineering and Process Engineering form the foundation for designing and optimizing manufacturing workflows. Process Simulation and Process Control skills are applied daily to model processes and maintain consistent production quality. Manufacturing Operations knowledge enables effective collaboration with production teams to implement improvements and troubleshoot issues. Scrap Reduction expertise is critical for identifying inefficiencies and driving cost-saving initiatives. Proficiency in Minitab supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing production data to uncover trends and root causes, ensuring continuous process enhancement.

I. Job ProfileJob TitleEHS ManagerDepartmentEHS

II. Job Summary：
The EH&S Manager is responsible for overseeing diverse tasks related to environmental, health and safety needs.  Provide a safe and healthy working environment for all employees.     Implement improvement systems in order to eliminate work-related injuries and ensuring all employees are educated in safe work conditions, practices, and safety requirements.     Manage and monitor a solid and effective safety program, encompassing environmental, safety and health policies and procedures. This position is responsible for the ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification process and shall maintain the relevant management systems.      Responsible for the safe operation and protection of all facility assets. The EH&S Manager is responsible for ensuring the safety of all persons on site, including visitors.     
 
III. Job Functions and Duties
 
NO.Representative Duties
1Safety in the Work Environment :
 1.1  Evaluate work environment to ensure safe practices are established to prevent injuries, accidents, and eliminate work hazards.
 1.2  Design and implement safety program to include PPE, hearing protection and noise mapping,  heat stress, LOTO, confined space, hot permit program, electrical safety and fork truck safety, as part of the initial implementation plan.
 1.3 Provide safety direction and/or guidance to on-site contractors to ensure compliance with FGA safety rules, policies, and procedures. 
2Accident/Injury Investigation:
 2.1  Conduct accident investigations immediately upon notice of accident and/or injury; complete within 24 hours at the latest.
 2.2   Document interviews with employees and witnesses to the accident/injury.
 2.3  Identify root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
 2.4  Communicate details of accident and/or injury to Human Resources Director and President.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2.5  Complete and submit, if necessary, worker's compensation report, OSHA log, and other regulatory agencies, including environmental reporting.
 2.6  Update and maintain injury and accident statistics to evaluate performance level of program. 
3Establish a Culture of Safety:
 3.1  Instill a culture of safety throughout the organization.
 3.2  Conduct contractor safety training to ensure contractors comply with FGA safety rules, procedures, policies,  and perform work in a safe manner.
 3.3  Provide integrated solutions to potential safety hazards.
 3.4   Act as a EHS resource to plant management.
 3.5  Provide technical support and assist in resolving safety issues to aid production and maintenance goals. 
4Industrial Hygiene Program:
 4.1  Establish areas of industrial hygiene sampling and monitoring.
 4.2   Establish an annual schedule to conduct industrial sampling, including noise sampling.
 4.3  Complete and monitor sampling schedule to ensure a safe working environment.
 4.4  Immediately implement corrective actions where samplings are out of range. 
5Safety Training:
 5.1  Design and implement safety training for New Hire Orientation.
 5.2  Ensure employee understanding of EHS policies and procedures.
 5.3  Test and re-test for understanding and compliance.
 5.4  Monitor training courses for attendance and compliance for each employee. 
6Project Management:
 6.1  Manages, evaluates, and implements appropriate projects that reduce costs, reduces accidents and injuries, and contributes to improved performance of the safety program.

8Lead investigation of accidents, incidents, and near misses to identify causes and to determine how such accidents might be prevented in the future.  Compiles and submits required OSHA accident reports.
9Assist management in development and reporting of EHS performance metrics to facilitate continuous, ongoing improvement of the EHS efforts and results.
10Follows instructions and performs other duties as may be assigned by supervisor.

12Participates in and completes company-required training programs.
13Participates in Environmental, Health and Safety initiatives as set forth by the company.

detail.title: Integrated Management System Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Summary/Objective 
 Establish, maintain, and implement IMS; Auditing and monitoring IMS to meet law regulations, improve customer satisfaction and interested parties' expectations.

 

Essential Functions

  1. Compile an annual audit plan according to company management and related parties' requirements, and submit for review and approval.
  2. Organize and implement Audit according to the annual audit plan, and follow up audit findings to be closed.
  3. Responsible for the effective control of Integrated Management System documents.
  4. Organize internal audit, and be responsible for follow-up audit issue closure.
  5. Organize third-party audit, and be responsible for follow-up audit issue closure.
  6. Organize customer IMS audit, and be responsible for follow-up audit issue closure.
  7. Participate in the second-party audit of the new program.
  8. Responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of integrated management system training.
  9. Other duties as assigned by the Quality Manager.

 

Competencies

  1. Quality tools: IATF 16949, VDA6.3, FMEA/SPC/MSA/CP/APQP/PPAP, 8D, CSR etc.
  2. Other tools: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, RBA etc.
  3. Problem Solving/Analysis.
  4. Project Management.
  5. Communication Proficiency.
  6. Ethical Conduct.
  7. Time Management

 

Supervisory Responsibility

No supervisory responsibility in this position.

 

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. This role does call for an occasional need to go on to the plant floor or to go to off-site customer locations.

 

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. Must be able to distinguish between different colors and shapes of glass. 

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
 This is a full-time position - days of work are Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

 

Travel 

Travel is expected for this position.

 

Required Education and Experience

  1. A Bachelor’s Degree and two years in automotive Quality field IATF internal auditor, ISO14001, and ISO45001 internal auditor experience.

 

Preferred Education and Experience

  1. A Bachelor’s degree and 3 years in automotive Quality field IATF internal auditor, ISO14001, and ISO45001 internal auditor experience.
  2. A Master’s degree and 2 years in automotive Quality field IATF internal auditor, ISO14001, and ISO45001 internal auditor experience.

 

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

detail.title: In Process Quality Control
detail.jobDescription:
About Fuyao
Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North American market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW, and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.
 
Our Parent Company
Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia, and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of the Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of the Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few.

Position: IPQC (In Process Quality Control)

Classification: Non-Exempt

Direct Supervisor: In Process Quality Engineer

Backup: IPQC LEAD/GP12

Related KPI:

  • Customer Complaint
  • Liaison Feedback Times
  • Internal Batch Issues

                              

Summary/Objective 

Ensure that the parts being produced meet quality specifications. Help monitor part quality on the Production floor. 

 

Essential Functions

  1. Perform the First Piece Approval Process with Team Leads and Technicians to ensure the parts conform to standards.
  2. Monitor the quality of the parts on the line and ensure that the parts meet standards by performing sample audits on the first and last pieces.
  3. Check the primer path and primer quality on all the lines. 
  4. Perform Daily Process Audits online to make sure that processes are being followed. 
  5. Provide support in training GP12 in job duties and work instructions.
  6. Dock Audit is responsible for assigned programs.
  7. Help with containments and proper disposition of the non-conforming material found during Containment.
  8. Review and sign off on the production scrap produced by the shift.
  9. Alert all Departments of issues found on the Production Floor and Shipping Dock. Send out daily reports to document and escalate any findings. 
  10. Other duties as assigned by IPQE and IPQC LEAD

 

Competencies 

  1. Must be familiar with ISO/TS 16949
  2. Problem Solving/Analysis.
  3. Communication Proficiency.
  4. Ethical Conduct.
  5. Time Management

 

Supervisory Responsibility

Support IPQE and IPQC LEAD to monitor GP12.

 

Work Environment

  1. The job routinely operates on the Production Floor but may require the employee to go to the Shipping Dock/Area. IPQC Leads need to work on the computer to make daily reports.
  2. Must be 18 years or older

 

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

 

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This position requires the ability to lift glass over 20 lbs and remain active for most of the day. During this job the employee may have to kneel or squat. The employee must be able to distinguish between different colors and shapes of glass. 

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
 This is a full-time position. Days of work are Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

 

Travel 

Travel is not expected for this position.

 

Required Education and Experience

  1. Two years’ Automotive Quality.

 

Preferred Education and Experience

  1. A High School Diploma and 3 years of automotive Quality.

 

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The Supervisor in Training position is designed to develop future leaders within the Automotive industry. This role focuses on equipping candidates with the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively manage teams and enhance customer satisfaction. The primary end result is to ensure that all team members are performing at their best while delivering exceptional service to clients. Through hands-on training and mentorship, the Supervisor in Training will learn to implement best practices and drive operational excellence. Ultimately, this position aims to prepare individuals for a successful transition into a supervisory role, fostering both personal and professional growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing setting.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field.
  • Experience in a supervisory or leadership role, even in a volunteer capacity.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in overseeing daily operations of the team to ensure high-quality product delivery.
  • Participate in training sessions to learn effective team management and conflict resolution techniques.
  • Monitor team performance metrics and provide feedback to team members to enhance productivity.
  • Collaborate with senior supervisors to develop strategies for improving operational efficiency.

Skills:

Problem-solving skills will be utilized daily to address customer inquiries and team challenges effectively. Preferred skills such as leadership and coaching will be developed through training, allowing the candidate to guide their team towards success. Overall, a combination of these skills will enable the Supervisor in Training to foster a positive work environment and drive team performance.

detail.title: HR Administrator
detail.jobDescription:
Summary/Objective
The HR Administrator supports day-to-day Human Resources operations and ensures compliance with Michigan employment laws, company policies, and federal regulatory standards. This role is responsible for accurately compiling, maintaining, and safeguarding all personnel records. Duties include recording essential employee data such as contact information, compensation details, attendance, absences, performance documentation, disciplinary actions, and separation reasons. The HR Administrator prepares, files, and retrieves employment records and provides information only to authorized individuals in accordance with state and federal confidentiality requirements.

 

Essential Functions

  1. Process, verify, and maintain personnel-related documentation, including staffing, recruitment, training, grievances, performance evaluations, job classifications, and employee leaves of absence (including PMLA, FMLA, and company leave policies).
  2. Explain company personnel policies, benefits, and procedures to employees and job applicants.
  3. Maintain and update the HRIS (ADP Workday) database for each employee, including information such as new hires, earnings, attendance, leaves, and date/reason for terminations, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
  4. Generate weekly and monthly reports, including time and attendance; track employee and temporary employee points; monitor new hires and terminations; and administer disciplinary documentation in accordance with company policy.
  5. Answer questions regarding job requirements, eligibility, salaries, benefits, leave policies, and other employment-related information.
  6. Request and verify information from law enforcement (when Legally permissible), previous employers, and references to determine applicants' employment acceptability in compliance with FCRA and Michigan hiring regulations.
  7. Process and review employment applications to evaluate qualifications and determine applicant eligibility.
  8. Coordinate advertising or posting job vacancies and notify eligible or internal candidates of position availability.
  9. Process and review employment applications to evaluate qualifications or eligibility of applicants.
  10. Source and screen applicants meet specified job requirements and refer qualified candidates to hiring managers and schedule onsite or virtual interviews
  11. Inform job applicants of their hiring status, including selection, rejection, or further steps in the hiring process.
  12. Retrieve information from personnel files for authorized persons and organizations only, ensuring compliance with confidentiality, Michigan record retention requirements, and FCRA.
  13. Administer and score applicant and employee assessments (aptitude, personality, or skills evaluations) in accordance with validated and job-related criteria.
  14. Prepare badges, passes, and identification cards, and assist with security-related procedures.
  15. Coordinate in-house and external training activities, including scheduling, sending notices, and tracking completion.
  16. Maintain compliance with federal and state regulations concerning employment, labor laws, safety (MIOSHA), wage and hour, and company policies.
  17. Handle and maintain the accuracy of each department’s training records, sending reminders and assisting department heads with proper completion and documentation.

 

Competencies

  1. Human Resources Capacity.
  2. Problem Solving/Analysis.
  3. Project Management.
  4. Detail Oriented 
  5. Communication Proficiency.
  6. Ethical Conduct.
  7. Time Management

 

Work Environment

  1. This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely involves standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
  2. Must be 18 years or older

 

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate, both verbally and through active listening. The role is primarily sedentary; however, some physical activity is required for filing and general office tasks. This includes lifting and carrying files, opening and closing filing cabinets, and bending, reaching, or standing on a stool as needed. Lifting, bending, and reaching overhead are common physical requirements of the position.

 

Travel 

Little to no travel is expected for this position.

 

Required Education and Experience

Associate’s degree in human resources or related field and 2+ years Human Resource experience.

detail.jobDescription:
Summary/Objective: 
Reporting to Fuyao Automotive North America, Inc., this position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations. The EHS Manager establishes goals and metrics, drives safety leadership, fosters a strong safety culture, and ensures environmental management best practices. As an integral member of the site leadership team, this role influences decision-making and promotes cross-functional collaboration to enhance workplace safety and compliance.


Essential Functions:

  1. Leads and/or assists in the implementation of comprehensive environmental, safety and health programs, policies, and procedures.
  2. Monitors regulatory arena for new/changing regulations and rulemaking; adjusts programs/procedures accordingly.
  3. Leads risk identification programs (including various inspection programs); act as a technical resource for the sharing of regulatory requirements and best practices.
  4. Leads safety related audit and inspection processes and open issues tracking.
  5. Serves as technical resource for incident investigation and causal factor/root cause analysis may lead investigations.
  6. Liaisons with and provides recommendations to Develops, implements, and oversees site-wide environmental, health, and safety policies and procedures.
  7. Monitors and ensures compliance with all applicable EHS regulations, including MIOSHA, EPA, NIOSH, and NFPA standards.
  8. Identifies and mitigates workplace hazards through risk assessments, audits, and inspections.
  9. Leads incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
  10. Establishes and tracks key safety performance metrics (leading and lagging indicators) to drive continuous improvement.
  11. Maintains required regulatory records and ensures timely submission of reports and notifications.
  12. Coordinates and communicates EHS policies and updates across all departments and levels of the organization.
  13. Ensures proper environmental testing and compliance, including hazardous/non-hazardous waste management, wastewater, stormwater, air permitting, and chemical safety.
  14. Develops and delivers EHS training on topics such as hazard communication, machine guarding, energy control (LOTO), industrial hygiene, fall protection, confined space entry, and emergency response.
  15. Works closely with the safety committee and management team to resolve identified safety concerns and implement corrective actions.
  16. Assists in identifying and fulfilling safety-related training needs to ensure workforce competency and compliance.
  17. Evaluates and recommends EHS-related equipment, protective devices, and facility modifications to enhance workplace safety.
  18. Serves as a key advisor to senior leadership on EHS-related risks, solutions, and best practices.
  19. Fosters a culture of safety excellence by driving employee engagement and accountability in EHS initiatives.
  20. Continuously assesses and improves safety programs to reduce injuries and enhance overall safety performance.

detail.title: Product Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
About Fuyao 

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers. 

Our Parent Company 

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few. 


Product Engineer

The purpose of this position is to function as a Product Engineer as part of triangle team. This position requires a knowledgeable and committed professional who is self-directed with a strong sense of responsibility for his/her work. This person has strong engineering skills, organizational skills and the ability to comprehend a total business situation, acting quickly, effectively, and prudently to enhance customer and Fuyao’s value. 

 

Essential Functions
 
 1. Analyze OEM drawings and quotations, design and develop process flow charts, engineering requirements, manage APQP files.
 2. Evaluate customer engineering changes, change tools and documents, manage the engineering changes.
 3. Plan and define new products, convert to company documents and standards.
 4. Organize the production team and follow up with the reviews and inspections.
 5. Develop the tool from design until buy off, including molds/Assemble fixtures/Checking fixtures. 
 6. Develop the process, track open issues until being fixed.
 7. Improve the manufacturing process and monitoring the process flow chart.
 8. Follow up in OEM plants related to products functionality, improve the parts to meet with customer expectation.
 9. Assist in the Support activities for all phases of prototype, pre-production and production start-up through vehicle launch, plus 3 months.
 
 Competencies
 • Personal Computer literate, with analytical decision-making skills
 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
 Must have training in:
 • FMEA ( Failure Mode Effects Analysis )
 Must be familiar with:
 • IATF 16949
 • PPAP ( Production Part Approval Process)
 • APQP ( Advanced Product Quality Planning )
 • SPC ( Statistical Process Control )
 • Through understanding of Automotive procedures and processes
 • Previous Automotive Injection molding Experience
 • Thorough understanding of Fuyao products, specifications, and tolerances

 1. Serve as a coach and mentor for this position in the department.
 
 Work Environment

 Must be  above 18 years old

 This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

About Fuyao 

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers. 

Our Parent Company 

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. Summary/Objective

The Junior Program Manager works with the Product Development Engineer and Advance Quality Engineer to quote, develop and launch new automotive glass products for OEMs.   The Junior PM will communicate directly with the customer on all matters concerning the initial launch of the program.   Represent Fuyao at customer development events and meetings.  Maintain documents in accordance with Fuyao policies, APQP and Customer deliverables.

 

Essential Functions

  1. New Product Launch - Automotive Glass (Mainly encapsulation) - Capable of handling OEM Customers and multiple programs/window openings.
  2. Internal leader of Iron Triangle and OEM program. Several forms of communication are required: face-to-face meetings, emails, texts, WeChat, verbal, written forms, etc.
  3. Key Player / Value stream leader for the OEM customer - "Voice of the Customer" for internal processes and proceedings. Organize internal teammates and processes to fulfill and support customer deliverables.
  4. Thoroughly understands purchasing procedure process and anticipates and handles any problems and questions pursuant to customer satisfaction.
  5. Maintaining the program budget and timing is a central requirement.  This includes components, tooling, equipment and packaging purchases and development. Responsible for COST: from Quote to Invoice. 
  6. Provide direction and support to program team (Fuyao Automotive North America and China), including scheduling meetings, updating open issues list, and any other project-related information.
  7. Creator of timing charts, ensure ON TIME delivery of products to the customer. Back-up plan and expedited delivery schedules.   Offset of delays
  8. Monitor and report on the progress of the project to all stakeholders, including reporting to company management.
  9. Attending engineering change meetings as needed at customer assembly and technical center. Responsible for implementing the engineering change in the plant.
  10. Within the first 90 days - acquire product and process knowledge - commensurate with leadership role.  Understand and be able to present to customer management core product lines.

detail.title: Process Technician
detail.jobDescription:
About Fuyao 

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers. 

Our Parent Company 

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few. 

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective
The Process Technician position is responsible for ensuring smooth running processes with minimum amount of downtime for process related issues. 

 

Essential Functions

  1. Meets and Monitors daily schedules, providing root causes and corrective actions for any unscheduled downtime and or missed production opportunities.
  2. Monitors all scrap produced that affect efficiencies and daily outputs
  3. Evaluate functionality and reliability of facility systems and associated equipment by conferring with departments, identifying problems and requirements.
  4. Maintains 5s standards across all shifts holding each line accountable for 5s compliance.
  5. Improves function and reliability of facility systems and associated equipment by studying performance results; identifying, recommending and implementing changes, expansions, and additions as it pertains to the current production lines.
  6. Maintains safe and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complying with legal codes and regulations.
  7. Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; technical publications.
  8. Attends daily meeting with supervisors to go over efficiencies, scrap, and people related issues and reports findings to the team.
  9. Conducts training for new hires to help guide them to the next level.

 

Competencies

  1. Basic knowledge of injection molding processes and machine functions
  2. Problem Solving/Analysis.
  3. Project Management.
  4. Communication Proficiency.
  5. Ethical Conduct.
  6. Time Management
  7. Injection Molding experience min 1-3 years
  8. Production  planning and troubleshooting experience
  9. Technical leadership and understanding
  10. Minimum 3 years automotive experience required


Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

 

Work Environment

This job operates between manufacturing and office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines as well as interfacing with the operation of machinery on the floor.

 

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position may require:

  1. Will require frequent standing and use of hands and arms
  2. Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds and frequently bend and twist from the waist

Frequently required to use hand and finger motions, handle or feel objects, reach with hands

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

 

Travel 

Sometimes travel to our external trainer may be required.

 

Required Education and Experience

  1. Basic mechanical aptitude and manufacturing plant experience.

 

Preferred Education and Experience

  1. 3 years’ maintenance experience, understanding of injection molding machine systems and processing, basics robotics experience including program touch ups.

 

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Please Note:
We kindly ask that applicants do not visit our office in person to submit applications or inquire about the position. All applications must be submitted online through the designated platform.

Due to the volume of applications, we will only contact candidates whose qualifications closely match the requirements of the role. We appreciate your understanding.

detail.title: TOOLING ENGINEER
detail.jobDescription:
About the Role:

As a Tooling Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining the tools and equipment necessary for efficient manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and cost-effectiveness by ensuring that tooling solutions meet stringent specifications and operational requirements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance to optimize tooling designs and resolve any issues that arise during production. This role requires a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement to support evolving product lines and manufacturing technologies. Ultimately, your expertise will help drive the successful delivery of high-quality products while minimizing downtime and tooling-related costs.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or CATIA for tooling design.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, stamping, injection molding, or casting.
  • Experience with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and engineering drawings.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Engineering or related discipline.
  • Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) software and ERP systems.
  • Knowledge of automation and robotics integration in tooling design.
  • Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing certification.
  • Previous experience working in automotive, aerospace, or heavy machinery industries.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop tooling solutions including jigs, fixtures, dies, molds, and gauges to support manufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with product design and manufacturing teams to ensure tooling designs meet functional and quality requirements.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to optimize tooling designs for manufacturability and efficiency.
  • Oversee the fabrication, testing, and validation of tooling to ensure compliance with specifications and performance standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve tooling issues during production to minimize downtime and maintain product quality.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tooling designs, modifications, and maintenance activities.
  • Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance tooling performance and reduce manufacturing costs.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for tooling procurement and maintenance services.

Skills:

The required skills such as CAD proficiency and knowledge of manufacturing processes are essential for creating precise and functional tooling designs that meet production needs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills enable the engineer to troubleshoot tooling issues quickly and implement effective solutions to minimize production delays. Communication and collaboration skills are vital for working with cross-functional teams and suppliers to ensure tooling aligns with product and process requirements. Preferred skills like experience with PLM software and Lean methodologies support continuous improvement efforts and efficient management of tooling assets. Additionally, familiarity with automation technologies allows the engineer to design tooling that integrates seamlessly with modern manufacturing systems, enhancing overall productivity.

Languages: 

English,proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.

detail.title: Tooling engineer
detail.jobDescription:
About the Role:

As a Tooling Engineer based in the United States, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining the tools and equipment essential for manufacturing processes. Your expertise will ensure that tooling solutions are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with production goals, directly impacting product quality and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance to optimize tooling designs and troubleshoot issues. This role demands a proactive approach to continuous improvement, leveraging engineering principles to innovate and enhance tooling systems. Ultimately, your contributions will support the seamless production of high-quality products while minimizing downtime and manufacturing costs.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in tooling design and development within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for tooling design.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as machining, stamping, molding, or assembly.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with CNC programming and operation.
  • Knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) standards.
  • Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing certification.
  • Experience working in automotive, aerospace, or heavy machinery industries.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and validate tooling and fixtures to support manufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with product design and manufacturing teams to ensure tooling meets production requirements and quality standards.
  • Analyze existing tooling performance and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve tooling-related issues during production to minimize downtime.
  • Manage tooling documentation, including specifications, drawings, and maintenance records.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for tooling procurement and maintenance services.
  • Support the implementation of new manufacturing technologies and processes related to tooling.

Skills:

The required skills such as CAD proficiency and manufacturing process knowledge are essential for designing precise and functional tooling that meets production needs. Problem-solving abilities enable the engineer to quickly identify and resolve tooling issues, ensuring minimal disruption to manufacturing. Collaboration skills are vital as the role involves working closely with multiple departments to align tooling solutions with product and process requirements. Preferred skills like CNC programming and knowledge of GD&T enhance the engineer’s capability to create more sophisticated tooling and ensure dimensional accuracy. Additionally, certifications in Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing support continuous improvement initiatives, driving efficiency and quality in tooling operations.


3rd Shift (11:00pm - 7:00am)
Must be 18 years of age or older.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Title: Program Manager

Job Summary: Leader of Program Management Team (Iron Triangle). Program Manager works with the Product Development Engineer and Advance Quality Engineer to quote, develop and launch new automotive glass products for OEMs. The PM will communicate directly with the customer on all matters concerning the initial launch of Windshields, Backlights, Doors, Quarter windows, and Sunroofs. Represent Fuyao at customer development events and meetings. Maintain documents in
 accordance with Fuyao policies, APQP and Customer deliverables.  

Job Functions

  • New Product Launch - Automotive Glass -Capable of handling OEM Customers and multiple programs/window openings.   
  • Communication single point contact with OEM customers. Internal leader of Iron Triangle and OEM program
  • Several forms of communication are required: face-to-face meetings, emails, texts, WeChat, verbal, written forms, etc
  • Key Player / Value stream leader for the OEM customer - "Voice of the Customer" for internal processes and proceedings
